# ciphertrust_aws_iam_roles_list (Data Source)

Use this data source to retrieve the list of AWS IAM roles for a given CipherTrust Manager AWS KMS.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List all IAM roles for a CipherTrust Manager AWS KMS
data "ciphertrust_aws_iam_roles_list" "all" {
  kms_id = ciphertrust_aws_kms.kms.id
}

# List the first 25 IAM roles whose path starts with /service-roles/
data "ciphertrust_aws_iam_roles_list" "service_roles" {
  kms_id      = ciphertrust_aws_kms.kms.id
  max_items   = 25
  path_prefix = "/service-roles/"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `kms_id` (String) ID of the CipherTrust Manager AWS KMS whose IAM roles are to be listed.

### Optional

- `max_items` (Number) Maximum number of IAM roles to return. If omitted, all roles are returned.
- `path_prefix` (String) Path prefix for filtering IAM roles (e.g. /division_abc/).

### Read-Only

- `roles` (Attributes List) List of IAM roles. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--roles))

<a id="nestedatt--roles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `roles`

Read-Only:

- `arn` (String) Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the IAM role.
- `assume_role_policy_document` (String) Trust policy document that grants an entity permission to assume the role.
- `create_date` (String) Date and time the IAM role was created.
- `description` (String) Description of the IAM role.
- `max_session_duration` (Number) Maximum session duration (in seconds) for the role.
- `path` (String) Path of the IAM role.
- `role_id` (String) Unique ID for the IAM role.
- `role_name` (String) Name of the IAM role.
